integrity_statement: All-parameter homotopy follows from a specified combinatorial finite-locality lemma, an exact stagewise discrete-Morse matching, and signed integral Morse cancellation in the n=5 boundary case. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to fully bidirected complete bipartite digraphs with bipartition sizes (2,n), n>=5.
The n>=6 homotopy proof combines finite exhaustive checking on a 9-leaf representative with an explicit locality transfer to all n.
Does not classify arbitrary orientations, larger small bipartition, equivariant modules, or unindexed equivalent results.
title: A torsion-to-sphere-wedge transition for bidirected bipartite multipath complexes
